name: greg
description: The checks Greg Aligiannis's reviews make repeatedly, so ours catch the same class of problems.

rules.rule:
- Contract check: when this PR pairs with an API / UI / mock-api-server PR, verify field names, statuses, enum values, error codes and ordering against the paired PR's HEAD, and say which commit you checked.
- Description truth: every claim in the PR description and in user-visible copy matches the code (e.g. a note says 'newest shown' while the query keeps the oldest).
- Outcome check: the linked issue's stated outcomes are actually delivered; scope creep across several issues in one PR is worth an optional 'split for review/revert' note.
- Caps and truncation: which rows survive a LIMIT matters (ORDER BY direction); unbounded responses (groups, facets) need a limit.
- Lifecycle edges: expiry/until fields honored at read time, status transitions the DB will refuse (409) handled, deleted/detached entities in history views.
- Tests pin the risky predicate (the guard that stops a foreign id), and the error/truncated branches the happy-path e2e never sends.
